metadata.question: Does surface water extent in Death Valley National Park increase in August 7, 2022 compared to July 11, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Death Valley National Park (need to define geometry or use known bounds) - Dates: July 11, 2022 and August 7, 2022 - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1/2 for water detection - Best approach: Use Sentinel-2 with NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or use dedicated water datasets 2. Masking strategy: - For water detection: Need to mask clouds heavily - Calculate NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) - Water threshold: NDWI > 0 typically indicates water - Compare total water pixels between two dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid Zero (B): If both dates have valid images and calculations succeed, but August water extent <= July water extent - A: If August water extent > July water extent - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Death Valley National Park geometry (approximate center and bounds) const deathValley = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-117.5, 35.9, -116.4, 37.0]); // 2. Define dates const julyDate = '2022-07-11'; const augDate = '2022-08-07'; // 3. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Function to get water extent function getWaterExtent(date, dateLabel) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(deathValley) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${dateLabel} images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Try Landsat 8/9 as fallback const colL = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterBounds(deathValley) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); const sizeL = colL.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${dateLabel} Landsat fallback images: ${sizeL}`); if (sizeL === 0) { return null; } const imgL = colL.first(); const ndwiL = imgL.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); const waterL = ndwiL.gt(0); const statsL = waterL.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: deathValley, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return { waterPixels: statsL.get('NDWI_sum').getInfo(), totalPixels: statsL.get('NDWI_count').getInfo() }; } const img = col.first(); const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); const water = ndwi.gt(0); const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: deathValley, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return { waterPixels: stats.get('NDWI_sum').getInfo(), totalPixels: stats.get('NDWI_count').getInfo() }; } // 5. Get water extent for both dates const julyStats = getWaterExtent(julyDate, 'July'); if (julyStats === null) { console.log('No data for July 11, 2022'); console.log('C1'); return; } const augStats = getWaterExtent(augDate, 'August'); if (augStats === null) { console.log('No data for August 7, 2022'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Check for valid pixels if (julyStats.totalPixels === 0 || augStats.totalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Check for calculation failures if (julyStats.waterPixels === null || augStats.waterPixels === null || isNaN(julyStats.waterPixels) || isNaN(augStats.waterPixels)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Output results console.log(`July 11: Water pixels = ${julyStats.waterPixels}, Total = ${julyStats.totalPixels}`); console.log(`August 7: Water pixels = ${augStats.waterPixels}, Total = ${augStats.totalPixels}`); // 9. Compare and answer if (augStats.waterPixels > julyStats.waterPixels) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
